Also, just a few things that tend to do really well on Instagram Reels! 💕
• Good lighting (natural light is best ☀️)
• Clear quality (not blurry or too shaky)
• A mix of angles (close-ups + full-body shots)
•Short, attention-grabbing clips in the first few seconds
Try not to make the focus too much on jiggling/overly explicit shots since Instagram can sometimes flag or limit the reach of those videos.
Talking-to-camera reels can perform really well too, so don't be afraid to include those!
